environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on EKS with Logback 1.2.11, writing structured logs to Elasticsearch via Logstash TCP appender. No input sanitization on log messages. SIEM dashboard renders log fields in Kibana with HTML rendering enabled. CDN scripts served over internal network without integrity verification enforcement by the browser (older Chromium 89 in kiosk mode for internal dashboards).

config.siem: Kibana 7.x with field HTML rendering enabled
config.browser: Chromium 89 kiosk mode (no SRI enforcement for internal origins)
config.network: flat internal network, CDN accessible without TLS pinning
